items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I was at his home about three weeks ago. I played out in a high school out there and I talked to Maurice French.

ctx.x: No, I don't remember exactly how he held it. No. I saw him play a parade or two and then he made some records with bunks. Yeah, he made records.
